strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第一話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()守護獣召喚&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)天城美由紀&s(165,82)&c(7)福岡&s(165,99)&c(7)天神高校&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)守護獣を呼べちゃうあたしって、なんかむちゃくちゃカッコイイ！　みんなは大丈夫かな、すぐに助けに行くからね！　阿蘇かぁ・・・ちっちゃいときに食べた温泉たまご、おいしかったな・・・。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 1&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Guardian Recall&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Miyuki Amagi&s(165,82)&c(7)Fukuoka&s(165,99)&c(7)Tenjin High&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I can summon Guardians! How&n()super-mega-cool am I?! Is everyone&n()okay? I'm coming to save you right now! Aso,&n()huh... The hot-spring eggs I ate there when I&n()was little were sooo yummy...

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第二話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()炎龍覚醒&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)炎真由&s(165,82)&c(7)熊本&s(165,99)&c(7)阿蘇山&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)学校のみんなば助け出せたとはよかけど、今度は鈴音さんのお姉さんば助けに宮崎に行く事になった。ちかなとの出会い、荏狗覇菟、そしてあん声・・・この先あたし、どうなるとやろか。少し不安。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 2&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Flame Dragon Awakens&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Mayu Homura&s(165,82)&c(7)Kumamoto&s(165,99)&c(7)Aso&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Good thing we got everybody from&n()school out, but now we're off to&n()Miyazaki to save Suzune-san's big sister.&n()Chikana, Egubado, that voice... What's gonna&n()happen to me now? Kinda scared.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第三話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()鈴音と琴音&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)周防ちかな&s(165,82)&c(7)宮崎&s(165,99)&c(7)はにわ園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)力強い協力者、美由紀と真由、双子の一の宮姉妹。阿蘇の龍脈は取り戻せた。だけど・・・嬉しいのに、何かひっかかってる。もう神門の、アタシだけの問題では、なくなっている気がする。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 3&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Suzune and Kotone&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Chikana Suo&s(165,82)&c(7)Miyazaki&s(165,99)&c(7)Haniwa Garden&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Strong allies: Miyuki and Mayu, and the&n()Ichinomiya twins. We got Aso's dragon&n()vein back. But... I'm glad, yet something's&n()nagging me. Feels like this isn't just the&n()Kamikado's problem, just mine, anymore.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第四話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()運命の再会&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)海原美里&s(165,82)&c(7)大分－愛媛&s(165,99)&c(7)瀬戸内海&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)由美・・・無事に生きていた事だけを喜んでいよう。荏狗覇菟のせいで何もかも無くしたけれど、だからこそ、どんな事をしてもあんただけは、あんただけはこの手に取り戻す、取り戻してみせる。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 4&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Fateful Reunion&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Misato Kaibara&s(165,82)&c(7)Oita - Ehime&s(165,99)&c(7)Seto Inland Sea&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Yumi... For now I'll just be glad you're&n()alive. Egubado took everything from&n()me, and that's exactly why, whatever it takes,&n()you, at least you, I will take back with these&n()hands. I swear it.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第五話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()海龍覚醒&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)一の宮琴音&s(165,82)&c(7)愛媛&s(165,99)&c(7)桜井海岸&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)みんなの口が重い。美由紀ちゃんが笑わないのが辛い。きっとみんな同じ気持ち。せめて、由美さんは苦しみから解放されて、楽になったと思いたい。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 5&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Sea Dragon Awakens&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Kotone Ichinomiya&s(165,82)&c(7)Ehime&s(165,99)&c(7)Sakurai Beach&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)No one wants to talk. It hurts that&n()Miyuki-chan won't smile. I'm sure&n()everyone feels the same. At least I want to&n()believe Yumi-san is free of her pain now, and&n()at peace.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()四国脱出&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)炎真由&s(165,82)&c(7)香川－岡山&s(165,99)&c(7)瀬戸大橋&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)美里ば探すと決めて、美由紀が少し元気になった事が嬉しい。でもあたしはホントは美里の最後のつぶやき・・・たぶん美里も龍ん声ば聞いたとやろと思って、そっちの方ば気にしとる。自己嫌悪。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Escape from Shikoku&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Mayu Homura&s(165,82)&c(7)Kagawa - Okayama&s(165,99)&c(7)Seto Ohashi Bridge&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I'm glad Miyuki perked up some once we&n()decided to look for Misato. But truth is,&n()I keep frettin' over Misato's last words... I bet&n()she heard a dragon's voice too. I hate myself&n()for it.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()四国脱出&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)日之影蘭&s(165,82)&c(7)香川－岡山&s(165,99)&c(7)瀬戸大橋&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)かおるに会いたい。ひとりきりで何度もくじけそうになったけど、美由紀さんたちに出会ってまた元気になれた気がする。荏狗覇菟と戦うなんて本当は恐いけど、かおるに会える時まで、私・・・！
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Escape from Shikoku&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Ran Hinokage&s(165,82)&c(7)Kagawa - Okayama&s(165,99)&c(7)Seto Ohashi Bridge&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I want to see Kaoru. All alone, I nearly&n()gave up so many times, but meeting&n()Miyuki-san and the others gave me my&n()strength back. Fighting Egubado really scares&n()me, but until the day I see Kaoru again, I...!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()大鳴門橋の罠&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)飛知和景子&s(165,82)&c(7)徳島－兵庫&s(165,99)&c(7)大鳴門橋&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)たぶんみんな、私の力に気づいてしまった。でも誰も何も言わず、戸惑いながらも私を理解しようとしてくれている。優しい人たち・・・。美里さん、どうか無事でいて。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Trap on Onaruto Bridge&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Keiko Hichiwa&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokushima - Hyogo&s(165,99)&c(7)Onaruto Bridge&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I think everyone has noticed my power.&n()But no one said a thing; confused as&n()they are, they are trying to understand me.&n()Such kind people... Misato-san, please be safe.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()大鳴門橋の罠&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)一の宮鈴音&s(165,82)&c(7)徳島－兵庫&s(165,99)&c(7)大鳴門橋&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)由美って人ズルくない？　結局なにもかも美里に押しつけて自分だけさっさと楽になったんじゃない。他に方法が無かったなんて、あたしは思わないって美里に言いたいのよ。言わないけどさ。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Trap on Onaruto Bridge&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Suzune Ichinomiya&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokushima - Hyogo&s(165,99)&c(7)Onaruto Bridge&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Isn't that Yumi person kinda unfair? In&n()the end she dumped everything on&n()Misato and took the easy way out. I wanna tell&n()Misato I don't believe there was no other way.&n()Not that I will, though.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第七話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()悲しみと怒りを胸に&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)海原美里&s(165,82)&c(7)愛知&s(165,99)&c(7)名古屋地下街&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)危険をかえりみず私を追ってきてくれた彼女たちの手を、私は取ろうと思う。由美・・・私ひとりぼっちなんかじゃなかった。そう思い込もうとしてただけだって、今日やっと分かった。ばかだね私。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 7&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Sorrow and Anger in Our Hearts&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Misato Kaibara&s(165,82)&c(7)Aichi&s(165,99)&c(7)Nagoya Underground&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)They came after me with no thought&n()for the danger, and I think I'll take&n()their hands. Yumi... I was never all alone. I only&n()made myself believe I was; today I finally see it.&n()What a fool I am.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)天の章第八話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()飛龍覚醒&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)飛知和景子&s(165,82)&c(7)京都&s(165,99)&c(7)二条城&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)私の中に飛龍の心がある。不思議な気持ち。それにみんなが私を必要としてくれる。自分が誰かの役に立つ事があるなんて。美里さんに会ってから私、なんだか変わった気がする・・・変わっていく。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Sky, Episode 8&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Wind Dragon Awakens&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Keiko Hichiwa&s(165,82)&c(7)Kyoto&s(165,99)&c(7)Nijo Castle&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)The Wind Dragon's heart is inside me.&n()Such a strange feeling. And everyone&n()needs me. To think I could ever be of use to&n()someone. Since I met Misato-san, I feel I have&n()changed... that I am changing.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第一話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()襲撃！旅立ちの序曲&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)大地裕子&s(165,82)&c(7)北海道&s(165,99)&c(7)雪花旅館&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)聖ゆかり、変なヤツ。自分勝手でゴーインで・・・でも、ひかれる。守護獣も荏狗覇菟も、あたしにはまだよく分かんないけど、いいや。どーせタイクツしてたんだ。面白そうだから巻き込まれてみよっと。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 1&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Attack! Overture to a Journey&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yuko Daichi&s(165,82)&c(7)Hokkaido&s(165,99)&c(7)Yukibana Inn&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Yukari Hijiri. Weird girl. Selfish and&n()pushy... but I'm drawn to her. I still&n()don't really get Guardians or Egubado, but&n()whatever. I was bored anyway. Looks like fun,&n()so I'll let myself get dragged along.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第二話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()聖龍覚醒&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)聖ゆかり&s(165,82)&c(7)北海道&s(165,99)&c(7)大雪山&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)裕子や唯さんという協力者を得た代わりに、私は直江を失ってしまった。大きな痛手。でも直江の安否を気づかうより先に、私はあの声にとらわれている。聖龍のメッセージ・・・幻聴なんかじゃない。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 2&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Holy Dragon Awakens&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yukari Hijiri&s(165,82)&c(7)Hokkaido&s(165,99)&c(7)Mt. Taisetsu&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I gained allies in Yuko and Yui-san, but&n()lost Naoe in exchange. A heavy blow.&n()Yet before I worry for Naoe's safety, I find&n()myself captivated by that voice. The Holy&n()Dragon's message... It was no hallucination.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第三話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()激突！青函トンネル&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)静内さやか&s(165,82)&c(7)北海道－青森&s(165,99)&c(7)青函トンネル&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)なんか知らないうちに助かっちゃったって感じ。ゆかりってフケ顔の子が気に入らないけど、ま、いちおー恩もあるし。なんか大変そーだからほっとけないし。やっぱオトナがついててやんないとね。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 3&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Clash! Seikan Tunnel&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Sayaka Shizunai&s(165,82)&c(7)Hokkaido - Aomori&s(165,99)&c(7)Seikan Tunnel&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Li-ike, I got saved before I knew it.&n()That old-lady-faced Yukari bugs me,&n()but I kinda owe her. And they're in sooo much&n()trouble I can't leave 'em. They need a&n()grown-up around, ri-ight?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第四話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()鏡登場！荏狗覇菟の罠&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)小泊かおる&s(165,82)&c(7)青森&s(165,99)&c(7)恐山&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)なんだかなー。仲間になったとたん仲間割れだもんなー。蘭ちゃん探しもうまくいかないし、不動はウルサイし、なんかふんだりけったりかも。とりあえず、みんなそのうち仲直りしなよね。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 4&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Kagami Appears! Egubado's Trap&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Kaoru Kodomari&s(165,82)&c(7)Aomori&s(165,99)&c(7)Mt. Osore&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Geez. The minute I join up, the team&n()splits up. Looking for Ran-chan is going&n()nowhere, Fudo won't shut up... talk about a&n()rough day. Anyway, you guys better make up&n()sometime soon.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第五話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()龍泉洞大脱出！&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)岩見沢唯&s(165,82)&c(7)岩手&s(165,99)&c(7)龍泉洞&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)直江さんの事は、もとはといえば私が原因。ゆかりさんを責めるつもりじゃないけど、私は裕子と一緒に直江さんを探す。きっと助け出す。ゆかりさんが行けないというのなら、私が行かなくては。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 5&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Great Escape from Ryusendo!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yui Iwamizawa&s(165,82)&c(7)Iwate&s(165,99)&c(7)Ryusendo Cave&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)What happened to Naoe-san was my&n()fault to begin with. I don't mean to&n()blame Yukari-san, but I will search for&n()Naoe-san with Yuko. I will rescue her. If&n()Yukari-san cannot go, then I must.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()ふせげ！恐怖のダムダム作戦&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)大地裕子&s(165,82)&c(7)宮城&s(165,99)&c(7)七ヶ宿ダム&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)鏡の単細胞。アイツどっかキレてるよ、爆発させりゃいいと思ってんだからさ。それにしても、あたしって変なヤツばっか寄って来る・・・さすらいのヒーロー、気になる。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Stop Operation Dam-Dam!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yuko Daichi&s(165,82)&c(7)Miyagi&s(165,99)&c(7)Shichikashuku Dam&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Kagami, you single-celled idiot. She's got&n()a screw loose, thinking blowing stuff up&n()fixes everything. And why do weirdos keep&n()flocking to me...? That wandering hero, though...&n()I'm curious.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()ふせげ！恐怖のダムダム作戦&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)平泉るり&s(165,82)&c(7)宮城&s(165,99)&c(7)七ヶ宿ダム&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)なにげについて来ちゃったのはいいけど、このヒトたちなんか激しい。ま、そこが気に入ったんだけどね。なんか面白くなりそう。はっ！　もしかして当分男ナシか？　いや～ん！　ちと大げさ？
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Stop Operation Dam-Dam!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Ruri Hiraizumi&s(165,82)&c(7)Miyagi&s(165,99)&c(7)Shichikashuku Dam&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I kinda tagged along on a whim, and&n()these people are kinda intense. Well,&n()that's what I like about 'em. This could get fun.&n()Wait! Does this mean no guys for a while? No&n()wa-ay! ...Am I overreacting?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第五話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()追撃！ストーンサークル&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)大地裕子&s(165,82)&c(7)秋田&s(165,99)&c(7)大湯環状列石&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)ゆかりは自分の思うとおりにすればいい。あたしは出来る限りゆかりを助けていこう。なにもかもゆかりと出会った事で始まったんだから。それにしても・・・さすらいのヒーロー、気になる。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 5&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Pursuit! The Stone Circle&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yuko Daichi&s(165,82)&c(7)Akita&s(165,99)&c(7)Oyu Stone Circles&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Yukari should just do what she thinks is&n()right. I'll help her as much as I can.&n()Everything started when I met Yukari, after&n()all. Still... that wandering hero... I'm curious.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()超破壊！荏狗覇菟基地&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)聖ゆかり&s(165,82)&c(7)？？？&s(165,99)&c(7)荏狗覇菟基地&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)確かにストーンサークルにいたのに、気がついたら荏狗覇菟の基地だったなんて。やはり荏狗覇菟には、人智を越えた何かが存在するに違いない。一刻も早く奴らの本拠地、東京へ行かなければ。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Smash! Egubado's Base&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yukari Hijiri&s(165,82)&c(7)???&s(165,99)&c(7)Egubado Base&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)We were surely at the stone circle, yet&n()when I came to, we were in Egubado's&n()base. Egubado must possess something beyond&n()human understanding. We must reach their&n()stronghold, Tokyo, without a moment's delay.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()超破壊！荏狗覇菟基地&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)平泉るり&s(165,82)&c(7)？？？&s(165,99)&c(7)荏狗覇菟基地&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)なにげについて来ちゃったのはいいけど、このヒトたちなんか激しい。ま、そこが気に入ったんだけどね。なんか面白くなりそう。はっ！　もしかして当分男ナシか？　いや～ん！　ちと大げさ？
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Smash! Egubado's Base&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Ruri Hiraizumi&s(165,82)&c(7)???&s(165,99)&c(7)Egubado Base&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I kinda tagged along on a whim, and&n()these people are kinda intense. Well,&n()that's what I like about 'em. This could get fun.&n()Wait! Does this mean no guys for a while? No&n()wa-ay! ...Am I overreacting?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第七話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()正義のロッカー晶参上！&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)雷晶&s(165,82)&c(7)新潟&s(165,99)&c(7)佐渡島&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)やはり私の他にも悪を憎む人々がいたです。悪を滅ぼし再び平和を取り戻すその日まで、みんなで力を合わせてがんばるです。ところで登場のタイミング、バッチリだったですよね？
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 7&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Akira, Rocker of Justice!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Akira Ikazuchi&s(165,82)&c(7)Niigata&s(165,99)&c(7)Sado Island&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Just as I thought, there are others&n()who hate evil too! Until the day we&n()destroy evil and restore peace, we shall join&n()forces and give it our all! By the way, my&n()entrance had perfect timing, did it not?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)地の章第八話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()突破せよ！試練の防衛線&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)直江巴澄&s(165,82)&c(7)福島&s(165,99)&c(7)猪苗代湖&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)私たちは自分の意志ではなく、龍の意志で動いているという事になるのだろうか。誰かの手のひらで踊らされるのはごめんだが、事の成り行きを最後まで、見とどけたい気持ちも捨てられない。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Earth, Episode 8&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Break the Line of Trials!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Hasumi Naoe&s(165,82)&c(7)Fukushima&s(165,99)&c(7)Lake Inawashiro&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Are we moving not by our own will, but&n()by the will of the dragons? I refuse to&n()dance in someone's palm, yet I cannot let go of&n()my wish to see this through to the very end.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第一話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()雷龍覚醒&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)仁瞳&s(165,82)&c(7)栃木&s(165,99)&c(7)日光東照宮&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)龍脈に雷龍が戻り、私は龍の使い手を、東京へと誘う。これが天命なのだろう。どちらにせよ、私は彼女たちと運命を共にしよう。迷うことはない。私は私の、信じた道を行くのだから。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 1&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Thunder Dragon Awakens&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Hitomi Jin&s(165,82)&c(7)Tochigi&s(165,99)&c(7)Nikko Toshogu&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)The Thunder Dragon has returned to&n()the dragon vein, and I will guide the&n()Dragon Wielder to Tokyo. This must be destiny.&n()Either way, I will share their fate. I will not&n()waver. For I walk the path I believe in.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第二話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()東京突入&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)大地裕子&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・港区&s(165,99)&c(7)東京タワー&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)新しい仲間と共に、あたしは今、東京に立っている。いよいよ荏狗覇菟の本拠地に乗り込んだんだ。でも、あの不思議な感覚は・・・初めて美由紀ちゃんに会った時感じたあれは、いったい・・・。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 2&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Into Tokyo&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yuko Daichi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Minato&s(165,99)&c(7)Tokyo Tower&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)With my new friends, I'm standing in&n()Tokyo now. We've finally charged into&n()Egubado's home turf. But that strange feeling...&n()the one I got when I first met Miyuki-chan,&n()what was it...?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第三話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()地上１５０メートルの戦い&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)天城美由紀&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・港区&s(165,99)&c(7)東京タワー&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)あたしの生まれた街が今ではこんな廃墟だなんて。荏狗覇菟は、龍鬼妃は、どうしてこんなコトするんだろう。やめさせなくちゃ。みんなを助けて戦うコトしかできないけど、でも、何かしなくちゃ。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 3&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Battle 150 Meters Up&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Miyuki Amagi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Minato&s(165,99)&c(7)Tokyo Tower&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)The city where I was born is all ruins&n()now. Why are Egubado and Ryukihi&n()doing this? I have to make them stop. All I can&n()do is help everyone and fight, but still, I have&n()to do something!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第四話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()偵察&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)周防ちかな&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)国会前庭洋式庭園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)龍鬼妃、七龍、龍の使い手、どれにも属さないアタシ、アタシの存在意義、アタシの価値・・・考えたくないのに。今は、天龍と地龍を目覚めさせる事だけを、考えなけりゃいけないのに。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 4&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Reconnaissance&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Chikana Suo&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)Diet Front Garden&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Ryukihi, the Seven Dragons, the Dragon&n()Wielder... I belong to none of 'em. My&n()reason to exist, my worth... I don't wanna think&n()about it. Right now all I gotta think about is&n()waking the Sky Dragon and the Earth Dragon.

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第五話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()武神登場！&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)天城美由紀&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・練馬区&s(165,99)&c(7)石神井公園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)裕子ちゃんが方向音痴で、ぜんぜん日比谷公園につけなかったけど、強いおじさんが仲間になった。みんな面白くて、一緒がすごく楽しい。でも早く行かなきゃ、仁たち待ちくたびれちゃうよね。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 5&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Takegami Appears!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Miyuki Amagi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Nerima&s(165,99)&c(7)Shakujii Park&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Yuko-chan has no sense of direction, so&n()we never found Hibiya Park, but a&n()super strong old guy joined us! Being with&n()everyone is sooo fun. But we gotta hurry, or&n()Jin and the others will get tired of waiting!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()日比谷包囲網&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)雷晶&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)日比谷公園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)裕子さんはケンカっぱやくて焦心苦慮です。美由紀さんのおかげでヤレヤレです。もし皇龍さんがホントにいたらあきれて帰ってしまうです。みなさん、合い言葉は一致団結なのです。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()The Hibiya Siege&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Akira Ikazuchi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)Hibiya Park&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Yuko-san is so quick to pick fights, it&n()fills me with anxious woe! Thanks to&n()Miyuki-san, crisis averted. If the Emperor&n()Dragon truly exists, it would leave in disgust!&n()Everyone, our watchword is: united we stand!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第五話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()日比谷包囲網&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)雷晶&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)日比谷公園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)裕子さんはケンカっぱやくて焦心苦慮です。美由紀さんのおかげでヤレヤレです。もし皇龍さんがホントにいたらあきれて帰ってしまうです。みなさん、合い言葉は一致団結なのです。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 5&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()The Hibiya Siege&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Akira Ikazuchi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)Hibiya Park&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Yuko-san is so quick to pick fights, it&n()fills me with anxious woe! Thanks to&n()Miyuki-san, crisis averted. If the Emperor&n()Dragon truly exists, it would leave in disgust!&n()Everyone, our watchword is: united we stand!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第七話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()国会議事堂へ&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)海原美里&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)国会議事堂正門前&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)国会議事堂が、龍脈が目の前だっていうのに、四門に張られた結界を壊しに行くことになった。これ壊さなきゃ入れないんだから仕方ないけど、イライラする。ところで私、誰と組むんだろ。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 7&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()To the National Diet Building&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Misato Kaibara&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)National Diet Building&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)The National Diet Building, the dragon&n()vein, right in front of us, and now we&n()have to go break the barrier on the Four&n()Gates. We can't get in otherwise, so fine, but it&n()drives me crazy. So who am I teaming up with?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()国会議事堂へ&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)海原美里&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)国会議事堂正門前&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)国会議事堂が、龍脈が目の前だっていうのに、四門に張られた結界を壊しに行くことになった。これ壊さなきゃ入れないんだから仕方ないけど、イライラする。ところで私、誰と組むんだろ。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()To the National Diet Building&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Misato Kaibara&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)National Diet Building&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)The National Diet Building, the dragon&n()vein, right in front of us, and now we&n()have to go break the barrier on the Four&n()Gates. We can't get in otherwise, so fine, but it&n()drives me crazy. So who am I teaming up with?

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第八話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()四門の結界&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)天城美由紀&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)国会前庭洋式庭園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)みんなの顔が、ちょっとずつコワくなってる気がする。敵が強くってタイヘンになってるから、四門将とか龍鬼妃にどんどん近づいてるって分かるから・・・でも大丈夫だよね、みんなが一緒だもん。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 8&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Barrier of the Four Gates&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Miyuki Amagi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)Diet Front Garden&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I feel like everyone's faces are getting&n()a little scarier. The enemies are getting&n()tough, so we know we're getting closer to the&n()Four Gate Generals and Ryukihi... But it'll be&n()okay, right? We're all together!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)七龍の章第七話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()四門の結界&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)天城美由紀&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)国会前庭洋式庭園&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)みんなの顔が、ちょっとずつコワくなってる気がする。敵が強くってタイヘンになってるから、四門将とか龍鬼妃にどんどん近づいてるって分かるから・・・でも大丈夫だよね、みんなが一緒だもん。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Seven Dragons, Episode 7&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Barrier of the Four Gates&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Miyuki Amagi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)Diet Front Garden&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)I feel like everyone's faces are getting&n()a little scarier. The enemies are getting&n()tough, so we know we're getting closer to the&n()Four Gate Generals and Ryukihi... But it'll be&n()okay, right? We're all together!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)覚醒の章第五話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()天地覚醒&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)海原美里&s(165,82)&c(7)東京・千代田区&s(165,99)&c(7)国会議事堂&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)七龍の新たな覚醒を目の当たりにして、真由たちは単純に感動してる。でも私は少し不安になった。ここにいるのは私の意志だけど、でも違うのかも知れない。誰かの思うまま、由美の事さえ・・・。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Awakening, Episode 5&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Heaven and Earth Awaken&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Misato Kaibara&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo, Chiyoda&s(165,99)&c(7)National Diet Building&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Seeing the Seven Dragons awaken&n()anew, Mayu and the others are simply&n()moved. But it makes me uneasy. I'm here by my&n()own will... or am I? Maybe it's all someone's&n()design, even what happened to Yumi...

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)覚醒の章第六話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()突入！妃龍鬼殿&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)大地裕子&s(165,82)&c(7)東京湾&s(165,99)&c(7)妃龍鬼殿・前&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)妃龍鬼殿を前にして、ゆかりでさえ弱気になってる。カラ元気でも元気って言うじゃん、パーッと行こうよパーッと！
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Awakening, Episode 6&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Storm Hiryuki Palace!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Yuko Daichi&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo Bay&s(165,99)&c(7)Outside Hiryuki Palace&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Facing Hiryuki Palace, even Yukari's&n()losing her nerve. Fake cheer is still&n()cheer, right? Let's go all out, all out!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)覚醒の章第七話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()決戦！四門将&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)炎真由&s(165,82)&c(7)東京湾&s(165,99)&c(7)妃龍鬼殿・前&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)荏狗覇菟は七つの龍脈が交わる場所、日本最大の龍脈に妃龍鬼殿ばぶつけようとしとる。龍があたしたちに宿った本当の理由が、今やっと分かった。龍鬼妃ば止めんと。妃龍鬼殿が動き出す前に！
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Awakening, Episode 7&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()Showdown! Four Gate Generals&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Mayu Homura&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo Bay&s(165,99)&c(7)Outside Hiryuki Palace&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Egubado's fixin' to ram Hiryuki Palace&n()into Japan's biggest dragon vein,&n()where all seven meet. Now I get why the&n()dragons came to live in us. We gotta stop&n()Ryukihi. Before Hiryuki Palace starts movin'!

strings.jp: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)覚醒の章第八話&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()出現！合体守護獣ぬえ&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)仁瞳&s(165,82)&c(7)東京湾&s(165,99)&c(7)妃龍鬼殿・前&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)ぬえの異常な回復力に苦しい戦いを強いられる。せめて、龍の使い手だけは、妃龍鬼殿へ・・・お前たちに、すべてを託す。
strings.en: &f(32,32)&s(116,26)&c(0)Awakening, Episode 8&f(32,32)&s(0,43)&c(0)&e()The Combined Guardian Nue!&d()&s(165,65)&c(7)Hitomi Jin&s(165,82)&c(7)Tokyo Bay&s(165,99)&c(7)Outside Hiryuki Palace&f(18,12)&s(40,120)&c(0)Nue's unnatural healing forces a&n()grueling battle on us. At least the&n()Dragon Wielder must reach Hiryuki Palace... I&n()entrust everything to you all.
